sub_graphs.title: EIP-145: SHL (Shift Left) Instruction Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution lifecycle of the SHL opcode for left bitwise shifting

nodes.label: SHL Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched opcode 0x1b (SHL) from bytecode

nodes.label: Pop Shift Amount
nodes.description: Pop first stack value arg1 (shift amount, unsigned)

nodes.label: Pop Value to Shift
nodes.description: Pop second stack value arg2 (value to be shifted)

nodes.label: Operands Ready
nodes.description: Both shift amount and value are available for computation

nodes.label: Check Shift Bounds
nodes.description: Check if shift amount >= 256

nodes.label: Shift Out of Bounds
nodes.description: Shift amount is >= 256, result will be 0

nodes.label: Compute Shift Left
nodes.description: Calculate (arg2 * 2^arg1) mod 2^256

nodes.label: Push Result to Stack
nodes.description: Push computed result (or 0 for out-of-bounds) to stack

nodes.label: SHL Execution Complete
nodes.description: SHL instruction completed, 3 gas consumed

sub_graphs.title: EIP-145: SHR (Logical Shift Right) Instruction Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution lifecycle of the SHR opcode for logical right shifting with zero fill

nodes.label: SHR Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched opcode 0x1c (SHR) from bytecode

nodes.label: Pop Shift Amount
nodes.description: Pop first stack value arg1 (shift amount, unsigned)

nodes.label: Pop Value to Shift
nodes.description: Pop second stack value arg2 (value to be shifted)

nodes.label: SHR Operands Ready
nodes.description: Both shift amount and value available

nodes.label: Check SHR Bounds
nodes.description: Check if shift amount >= 256

nodes.label: SHR Out of Bounds
nodes.description: Shift >= 256, result is 0

nodes.label: Compute Logical Shift Right
nodes.description: Calculate floor(arg2 / 2^arg1) with zero fill

nodes.label: Push SHR Result
nodes.description: Push computed result to stack

nodes.label: SHR Execution Complete
nodes.description: SHR instruction completed, 3 gas consumed

sub_graphs.title: EIP-145: SAR (Arithmetic Shift Right) Instruction Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution lifecycle of the SAR opcode for arithmetic right shifting with sign extension

nodes.label: SAR Opcode Fetched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched opcode 0x1d (SAR) from bytecode

nodes.label: Pop Shift Amount
nodes.description: Pop first stack value arg1 (shift amount, unsigned)

nodes.label: Pop Signed Value
nodes.description: Pop second stack value arg2 (treated as signed 256-bit integer)

nodes.label: SAR Operands Ready
nodes.description: Shift amount (unsigned) and value (signed) available

nodes.label: Check SAR Bounds
nodes.description: Check if shift amount >= 256

nodes.label: Check Sign Bit
nodes.description: Determine if arg2 is negative (sign bit set)

nodes.label: SAR OOB Positive Value
nodes.description: Shift >= 256 with non-negative value, result is 0

nodes.label: SAR OOB Negative Value
nodes.description: Shift >= 256 with negative value, result is -1 (all 1s)

nodes.label: Compute Arithmetic Shift Right
nodes.description: Calculate floor(arg2 / 2^arg1) with sign extension

nodes.label: Push SAR Result
nodes.description: Push computed result to stack

nodes.label: SAR Execution Complete
nodes.description: SAR instruction completed, 3 gas consumed

ambiguities.text: The specification states SAR 'operates on signed numbers' but arg1 (shift amount) is 'considered as an unsigned number'.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume arg2 (the value to shift) is treated as a two's complement signed 256-bit integer, while arg1 (shift amount) is always unsigned. This is consistent with the edge case behaviors described.

ambiguities.text: Stack underflow behavior when fewer than 2 elements are on the stack is not explicitly specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM stack underflow behavior applies: execution fails with a stack underflow error if fewer than 2 elements are available.

implicit_assumptions.description: EVM implementations consistently handle 256-bit arithmetic with proper overflow/underflow semantics.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Different implementations could produce different results for edge cases, leading to consensus failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: Contracts relying on the new opcodes will only be deployed on chains that have activated the fork containing EIP-145.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts using SHL/SHR/SAR on pre-fork chains would encounter invalid opcode errors.

implicit_assumptions.description: The floor() function for SAR produces consistent results across all implementations for negative dividends.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent rounding behavior could lead to different results across clients, causing consensus splits.
